display_name: 화이트 원형 테이블과 타일 바닥의 공간감 항공샷

composition.subject_anchor_priority: one complete primary beverage sits just below center on the right-dominant round white table; one secondary dessert group sits above it at twelve o'clock and a cropped magazine remains peripheral at the far right edge; keep the table edge and left floor wedge visible
asymmetry_sources: large circular table entering from the right
narrow gray tiled-floor wedge on the left
broad partial shadows cast by unseen room elements

environment.background_plane: one large matte warm-neutral white circular tabletop above a gray tiled cafe floor visible only as a narrow left wedge
environment.surface_character: clean plain warm-neutral white painted or matte-laminate cafe table with only extremely subtle fine grain and low-amplitude real-world imperfections; preserve light gradients and shadows but prohibit marble veins, cloudy mottling, faux-stone blotches, plaster, paper, canvas, stains, repeated AI texture, procedural noise and synthetic render smoothness; allow only the declared dessert plate, Basque cheesecake, fork and cropped BAUHAUS magazine
environment.sun_patch_shape: broad irregular soft-edged tonal patches from off-frame window obstructions, never a crisp leaf or furniture silhouette

dessert_group.anchor: twelve o'clock above the primary beverage
dessert_group.plate: one modest warm-white matte ceramic plate with a shallow raised rim and attached contact shadow
dessert_group.cake: one triangular Basque burnt cheesecake slice with a gently sunken center, slightly higher irregular outer rim, dark caramelized top, thick pale finely porous cream-cheese middle and thin darker baked base; never sponge or castella
dessert_group.fork: one slim four-tine stainless-steel dessert fork across the lower plate, tines left and handle right, not touching the cake

magazine_group.anchor: far right edge around two-to-three o'clock
magazine_group.appearance: cropped peripheral portion of the published white BAUHAUS magazine with bold black title, gray architectural cover graphic and visible white edge or spine

lighting.source: one large upper-left window diffused by room air and partial off-frame architecture or furniture
lighting.shadow_description: a compact attached product shadow plus broad low-density environmental shadows crossing both floor and table from objects outside the frame
lighting.ambient_fill: neutral room bounce that keeps white-table texture and gray-floor depth readable
lighting.highlight_behavior: soft protected white highlights with table texture, cup rim and beverage surface retained
lighting.shadow_temperature: neutral to faintly cool relative to the warm-neutral table

capture.shadow_processing: retain the spatial separation between elevated tabletop, receding floor and off-frame room volume
capture.local_texture: retain ceramic or source-container construction, beverage identity, ice and toppings without artificial microcontrast

human_rendering.skin_texture: not applicable because no hand is active
human_rendering.light_response: not applicable because no hand is active

material_rules.glass: in source-family mode rebuild a simple glass in the same broad family and material under the target overhead camera; exact source height, taper, sidewall geometry and branding are not invariants. In adopt-reference mode reconstruct only the versioned opaque white ceramic mug. Keep rim, ice, liquid and attached shadow physically connected
material_rules.plastic: in source-family mode rebuild a simple plastic cup in the same broad family and material under the target overhead camera and never add an unverified lid or straw; in adopt-reference mode obey the separate versioned opaque ceramic container contract

coupling_rules: Product, table, floor and environmental shadows belong to one upper-left window exposure.
The curved table edge and receding floor grout jointly communicate camera height and room depth.
The product stays fully on the table and owns one attached contact shadow.
Only the declared cup and companion-scene designs may transfer; reference beverage, latte art, exact shadow silhouette and exact pixel layout are excluded.
The dessert group stays secondary above the mug, and the magazine stays cropped at the far right edge.
The fork tines point left and the handle extends right below the cake without overlap.
forbidden: bread, flower, phone or any undeclared decorative prop; source saucer, support plate and spoon are allowed only when present in reconstruct_source mode
any book or magazine other than the declared cropped BAUHAUS magazine
marble veining, cloudy mottling, faux-stone patches, plaster texture, repeated procedural noise or CGI-smooth tabletop
castella, sponge, chiffon, pound-cake or bread-like cheesecake texture
fruit, cream, sauce, ice cream, label card or garnish on the cheesecake plate
visible chair, plant or furniture body
flat white seamless background with no floor wedge
crisp graphic sunlight or copied shadow silhouette
copied reference coffee, crema or latte art
invented text, logo or watermark outside the declared BAUHAUS magazine

hard_fail: the round table edge or left gray floor wedge disappears
floor grout does not recede or the table reads as a flat background
broad off-frame environmental shadow atmosphere is absent
fabric, coaster, napkin or an undeclared decorative prop appears; source saucer, support plate and spoon are allowed only when present in reconstruct_source mode
the cheesecake lacks a sunken center, higher irregular rim or three-zone cut face
the fork tines do not point left or the handle does not extend right below the cake
the declared BAUHAUS magazine is missing, substituted, enlarged or moved inward
the tabletop reads as marble, mottled faux stone, procedural AI texture or a synthetic render
product is cropped, floats or lacks an attached contact shadow
reference coffee or latte art replaces the user beverage, or the exact reference shadow silhouette leaks
product inherits the oblique source camera instead of the target overhead camera
cup rim is strongly elliptical or too much sidewall is visible
beverage color, syrup or fruit appears on an opaque cup exterior or base
